558a25: Of the serpents, the viper gives birth to live young externally, first having produced eggs within itself,
558a26: first having laid the egg internally; and the egg, like that of fishes, is uniform in color
558a29: of fishes. It brings forth small vipers in membranes, which burst open

558a31: It brings forth one at a time in a single day, and brings forth more than twenty.
